import numpy as np, json
from robot import tools, handoff
from ora_lib import current, object_geometry
import scene as S

ARM = "left"
WANT = np.array([-0.10, -0.25])
TOL_FIND = 0.03

r = tools.vision_ground(camera="head", text="golden ring", max_candidates=3)
if not r.ok or r.status != "candidates":
    handoff("ring grounding failed", status=r.status)
cands = r["result"]["candidates"]
def dist(c):
    g = object_geometry(c)
    return float(np.hypot(g.center_xyz_m[0]-WANT[0], g.center_xyz_m[1]-WANT[1])), g
scored = sorted([(dist(c)[0], c, dist(c)[1]) for c in cands], key=lambda t: t[0])
d0, best, g = scored[0]
print("ring candidates:", [(round(s[0],4), s[1]["candidate_id"]) for s in scored])
if d0 > TOL_FIND:
    handoff("target ring not among candidates", best_dist_m=d0, need_m=TOL_FIND)
print("chosen ring world", np.round(g.center_xyz_m,4).tolist())

plan = tools.grasp_plan(arm=ARM, target_ref=best["target_ref"], max_candidates=3)
if plan.status != "candidates":
    handoff("no grasp candidate", status=plan.status, summary=plan.summary)
pc = sorted(plan["result"]["candidates"], key=lambda c: c["rank"])[0]
print("plan cand", pc["candidate_id"], "opening", pc["gripper_opening_m"],
      "contact", np.round(pc["contact_pose"]["position_m"],4).tolist(),
      "reachable", pc["ik_reachability"]["reachable"])

ex = tools.grasp_execute(candidate_id=pc["candidate_id"],
                         rationale="top grasp of golden ring at x=-0.10 to place in a tic-tac-toe cell")
print("EXEC ok", ex.ok, "status", ex.status, "failure", ex.failure_code)
print("summary:", ex.summary)
print("stages:", json.dumps(ex["result"].get("stages"), default=str)[:2500])
print("verification:", json.dumps(ex["result"].get("verification"), default=str)[:1200])

obs = current()
tcp = obs.pose(ARM)
print("tcp after", np.round(tcp.xyz,4).tolist())
rep = S.report()
held = rep["held"]
if not held:
    handoff("no gold object lifted above table", tcp=np.round(tcp.xyz,4).tolist())
hbest = max(held, key=lambda d: d["area"])
print("held world", np.round(hbest["mean_world"],4).tolist(), "offset from tcp",
      np.round(np.array(hbest["mean_world"]) - np.array(tcp.xyz.tolist()),4).tolist())

import numpy as np, json
from robot import tools, handoff, target
from ora_lib import current, Point
import scene as S

ARM = "left"
CELL = (1, 1)
FINGER_TIP_M = 0.1576
TIP_CLEAR_M = 0.002
UP_M = 0.06
LIFT_M = 0.08
TOL_CENTRE_M = 0.015

obs = current()
h = S.head(obs)
ok, det = S.verify_board(h)
if not ok:
    handoff("board geometry not where cached", detail=det)
B = S.BOARD_CACHE
cell = S.cell_centre(*CELL, B)
top = B["top_z"]

reset = {"left": np.array([-0.2995290756225586, -0.35229986906051636, 0.921500027179718]),
         "right": np.array([0.3004709482192993, -0.35229986906051636, 0.921500027179718])}
tcp0 = obs.pose(ARM)
approach = np.array(tcp0.axis("x"))
print("tcp0", np.round(tcp0.xyz, 4).tolist(), "approach", np.round(approach, 4).tolist())
if approach[2] > -0.95:
    handoff("approach not vertical", approach=approach.tolist())
z_release = top + TIP_CLEAR_M - FINGER_TIP_M * approach[2]
p_down = Point(np.array([cell[0], cell[1], z_release]), frame="world")
p_above = Point(np.array([cell[0], cell[1], z_release + UP_M]), frame="world")
p_lift = Point(np.array([cell[0], cell[1], z_release + UP_M + LIFT_M]), frame="world")
print("cell", np.round(cell, 4).tolist(), "z_release", round(z_release, 4))

r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(p_above, interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
print("above:", r.ok, r.status, r.failure_code, r.summary, r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok:
    handoff("move above cell failed", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code)
r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(p_down, interaction="precision")}, speed="careful")
print("descend:", r.ok, r.status, r.failure_code, r.summary, "err", r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok:
    handoff("descend failed", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code)
rg = tools.set_gripper(targets={ARM: "open"})
print("open:", rg.ok, rg.status, rg.summary)
tools.wait_ticks(ticks=6)
r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(p_lift, interaction="precision")}, speed="careful")
print("lift:", r.ok, r.status, r.failure_code, r.summary)

obs = current()
h = S.head(obs)
ok, det = S.verify_board(h)
bp = S.board_pieces_cached(h)
occ = {k: v["n"] for k, v in sorted(bp.items()) if v["n"] > 30}
print("occupied cells:", occ)
c = bp[CELL]
if c["n"] <= 30:
    handoff("target cell not occupied after release", cell=CELL, cell_xy=c["cell_xy"], all=bp)
err = float(np.hypot(c["centre_xy"][0] - c["cell_xy"][0], c["centre_xy"][1] - c["cell_xy"][1]))
print("place err m", round(err, 4), "zmax", round(c["zmax"], 4), "zmed", round(c["zmed"], 4), "n_px", c["n"])
for a in ("left", "right"):
    p = obs.pose(a)
    print("arm", a, np.round(p.xyz, 4).tolist(), "dist_reset", round(float(np.linalg.norm(np.array(p.xyz.tolist()) - reset[a])), 5))
if err > TOL_CENTRE_M:
    handoff("ring not centred", err_m=err, tol_m=TOL_CENTRE_M, cell=CELL, detail=c)

away = [a for a in ("left", "right") if float(np.linalg.norm(np.array(obs.pose(a).xyz.tolist()) - reset[a])) > 0.0015]
print("arms away:", away)
if away:
    rh = tools.return_home(arms=away)
    print("return_home:", rh.ok, rh.status, rh.failure_code, rh.summary)
    obs2 = current()
    for a in ("left", "right"):
        print("after home", a, round(float(np.linalg.norm(np.array(obs2.pose(a).xyz.tolist()) - reset[a])), 5))
print("DONE")

import numpy as np, json
from robot import tools, handoff, target
from ora_lib import current, object_geometry, Point, Pixel
import scene as S

FINGER_TIP_M = 0.1576
TIP_CLEAR_M = 0.002
UP_M = 0.06
TABLE_RING_Z = (0.769, 0.781)     # ring on table: top ~0.7755
BOARD_PIECE_Z = 0.004             # piece sits this far above board top

def table_rings(h=None, min_px=40):
    h = h or S.head()
    out = []
    for d in S.gold_blobs(h, min_px=min_px):
        w = np.array(d["mean_world"])
        if w[1] < -0.15 and TABLE_RING_Z[0] <= d["zmax"] <= TABLE_RING_Z[1]:
            out.append(dict(xy=[float(w[0]), float(w[1])], area=d["area"], uv=d["uv"], zmax=d["zmax"]))
    # merge components of the same ring
    merged = []
    used = [False] * len(out)
    for i, a in enumerate(out):
        if used[i]:
            continue
        grp = [a]; used[i] = True
        for j in range(i + 1, len(out)):
            if not used[j] and np.hypot(out[j]["xy"][0] - a["xy"][0], out[j]["xy"][1] - a["xy"][1]) < 0.025:
                grp.append(out[j]); used[j] = True
        w = np.array([g["area"] for g in grp], dtype=float)
        xy = np.average([g["xy"] for g in grp], axis=0, weights=w)
        uvv = np.average([g["uv"] for g in grp], axis=0, weights=w)
        merged.append(dict(xy=[float(xy[0]), float(xy[1])], area=int(sum(w)), uv=[float(uvv[0]), float(uvv[1])],
                           n_parts=len(grp)))
    merged.sort(key=lambda d: d["xy"][0])
    return merged

def _target_ref_for_ring(h, ring, tol_m=0.02):
    """a current observation target_ref for one table ring"""
    r = tools.vision_ground(camera="head", text="golden ring", max_candidates=3)
    cands = r["result"]["candidates"] if r.ok else []
    best = None
    for c in cands:
        g = object_geometry(c)
        if g.center_xyz_m[2] > 0.79:
            continue
        d = float(np.hypot(g.center_xyz_m[0] - ring["xy"][0], g.center_xyz_m[1] - ring["xy"][1]))
        if d < tol_m and (best is None or d < best[0]):
            best = (d, c)
    if best is not None:
        return best[1]["target_ref"], "vision_ground", best[1]["candidate_id"], best[0]
    seg = tools.vision_segment(camera="head", points_uv=[ring["uv"]], max_candidates=2)
    if seg.ok and seg["result"]["candidates"]:
        c = seg["result"]["candidates"][0]
        return c["target_ref"], "vision_segment", c["candidate_id"], 0.0
    return None, None, None, None

def pick_ring(arm, ring_xy):
    """grasp the table ring nearest ring_xy with arm; verify it left the table"""
    h0 = S.head()
    rings0 = table_rings(h0)
    if not rings0:
        handoff("no rings on table", arm=arm)
    ring = min(rings0, key=lambda d: np.hypot(d["xy"][0] - ring_xy[0], d["xy"][1] - ring_xy[1]))
    d = float(np.hypot(ring["xy"][0] - ring_xy[0], ring["xy"][1] - ring_xy[1]))
    print("PICK target ring", np.round(ring["xy"], 4).tolist(), "dist_to_want", round(d, 4), "table rings", len(rings0))
    if d > 0.04:
        handoff("wanted ring not on table", want=ring_xy, nearest=ring["xy"], dist_m=d)
    tref, how, cid, md = _target_ref_for_ring(h0, ring)
    if tref is None:
        handoff("no target_ref for ring", ring=ring["xy"])
    print("  target_ref via", how, cid, "match_m", round(md, 4) if md else None)
    plan = tools.grasp_plan(arm=arm, target_ref=tref, max_candidates=3)
    if plan.status != "candidates" or not plan["result"]["candidates"]:
        handoff("no grasp candidate", status=plan.status, summary=plan.summary, ring=ring["xy"])
    pc = sorted(plan["result"]["candidates"], key=lambda c: c["rank"])[0]
    print("  grasp cand", pc["candidate_id"], "opening", round(pc["gripper_opening_m"], 4),
          "contact", np.round(pc["contact_pose"]["position_m"], 4).tolist(),
          "reachable", pc["ik_reachability"]["reachable"])
    ex = tools.grasp_execute(candidate_id=pc["candidate_id"],
                             rationale=f"{arm} top grasp of golden ring at {np.round(ring['xy'],3).tolist()} for tic-tac-toe")
    print("  EXEC", ex.ok, ex.status, ex.failure_code, "|", ex.summary)
    h1 = S.head()
    rings1 = table_rings(h1)
    still = [r for r in rings1 if np.hypot(r["xy"][0] - ring["xy"][0], r["xy"][1] - ring["xy"][1]) < 0.02]
    held = S.held_ring(h1)
    tcp = current().pose(arm)
    print("  after: table rings", len(rings1), "still-at-spot", len(still), "held blobs", len(held),
          "tcp", np.round(tcp.xyz, 4).tolist())
    ok = (not still) and len(held) > 0
    return dict(ok=ok, ring=ring, held=held[0] if held else None, rings_before=len(rings0),
                rings_after=len(rings1), grasp_cand=pc["candidate_id"])

def place_ring(arm, cell, do_verify=True):
    """lower the held ring into the cell, release, verify from head view"""
    obs = current()
    h = S.head(obs)
    okb, det = S.verify_board(h)
    if not okb:
        handoff("board geometry moved", detail=det)
    B = S.BOARD_CACHE
    top = B["top_z"]
    cell = np.array(cell, dtype=float)
    tcp0 = obs.pose(arm)
    approach = np.array(tcp0.axis("x"))
    if approach[2] > -0.95:
        handoff("approach axis not vertical", approach=np.round(approach, 3).tolist(), arm=arm)
    z_release = top + TIP_CLEAR_M - FINGER_TIP_M * approach[2]
    p_down = Point(np.array([cell[0], cell[1], z_release]), frame="world")
    p_above = Point(np.array([cell[0], cell[1], z_release + UP_M]), frame="world")
    r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(p_above, interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
    print("  above cell:", r.ok, r.status, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
    if not r.ok:
        handoff("move above cell failed", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code, arm=arm, cell=cell.tolist())
    r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(p_down, interaction="precision")}, speed="careful")
    print("  descend:", r.ok, r.status, r.failure_code, "err", r.target_error_m)
    if not r.ok:
        handoff("descend failed", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code, arm=arm, cell=cell.tolist())
    rg = tools.set_gripper(targets={arm: "open"})
    print("  release:", rg.ok, rg.status)
    tools.wait_ticks(ticks=6)
    res = dict(cell_xy=cell.tolist(), z_release=z_release)
    if do_verify:
        h = S.head()
        bp = S.board_pieces_cached(h)
        cellij = None
        best = 1e9
        for k, v in bp.items():
            dd = float(np.hypot(v["cell_xy"][0] - cell[0], v["cell_xy"][1] - cell[1]))
            if dd < best:
                best, cellij = dd, k
        c = bp[cellij]
        if c["n"] <= 30:
            handoff("cell empty after release", cell=cell.tolist(), cellij=cellij, detail=bp)
        err = float(np.hypot(c["centre_xy"][0] - c["cell_xy"][0], c["centre_xy"][1] - c["cell_xy"][1]))
        print("  placed in cell", cellij, "n_px", c["n"], "centring_err_m", round(err, 4),
              "zmax", round(c["zmax"], 4))
        res.update(cellij=cellij, err_m=err, n_px=c["n"], zmax=c["zmax"])
        if err > 0.015:
            handoff("ring not centred in cell", err_m=err, cellij=cellij, detail=c)
    return res

def arms_at_reset(obs=None):
    obs = obs or current()
    reset = {"left": np.array([-0.2995290756225586, -0.35229986906051636, 0.921500027179718]),
             "right": np.array([0.3004709482192993, -0.35229986906051636, 0.921500027179718])}
    q0 = np.array([-4.3274193412474856e-08, -6.000607587120325e-08, 0.7072135548501013, 0.7069999913976501])
    out = {}
    for a in ("left", "right"):
        p = obs.pose(a)
        d = float(np.linalg.norm(np.array(p.xyz.tolist()) - reset[a]))
        ang = 2 * np.degrees(np.arccos(min(1.0, abs(float(np.dot(np.array(p.xyzw), q0))))))
        out[a] = dict(dpos_m=d, ang_deg=ang, at_reset=(d <= 0.0015 and ang <= 1.0))
    return out

    r = tools.return_home(arms=list(arms))
    print("  return_home", arms, r.ok, r.status, r.failure_code, "|", r.summary)
    st = arms_at_reset()
    print("  reset state:", {a: (round(v['dpos_m'], 5), round(v['ang_deg'], 3), v['at_reset']) for a, v in st.items()})
    return st

def piece_bbox_centre(obs, cell_xy, cams=("head", "right_wrist", "left_wrist"), half=0.045, band=(0.006, 0.015), B=None):
    """centre of a board piece from its world-space gold bbox seen by the most complete view"""
    B = B or BOARD_CACHE
    cell_xy = np.asarray(cell_xy, dtype=float)
    best = None
    for name in cams:
        try:
            c = cam_cloud(obs, name)
        except Exception:
            continue
        gold = (c["hsv"][..., 0] > 0.09) & (c["hsv"][..., 0] < 0.24) & (c["hsv"][..., 1] > 0.30) & (c["hsv"][..., 2] > 0.20)
        X, Y, Z = c["world"][..., 0], c["world"][..., 1], c["world"][..., 2]
        m = (gold & np.isfinite(Z) & (Z > B["top_z"] + band[0]) & (Z < B["top_z"] + band[1])
             & (np.hypot(X - cell_xy[0], Y - cell_xy[1]) < half))
        n = int(m.sum())
        if n < 25:
            continue
        sx = float(np.nanmax(X[m]) - np.nanmin(X[m])); sy = float(np.nanmax(Y[m]) - np.nanmin(Y[m]))
        cen = [float((np.nanmax(X[m]) + np.nanmin(X[m])) / 2), float((np.nanmax(Y[m]) + np.nanmin(Y[m])) / 2)]
        score = min(sx, sy)
        rec = dict(camera=name, n=n, centre_xy=cen, span=[sx, sy], score=score,
                   err_m=float(np.hypot(cen[0] - cell_xy[0], cen[1] - cell_xy[1])),
                   zmed=float(np.nanmedian(Z[m])))
        if best is None or score > best["score"]:
            best = rec
    return best

bp0 = S.board_pieces_cached(h0)

    handoff("unexpected board state", occupied=occ, free=free)

# opponent settled?
wa0 = S.white_arm_lowest_v(h0)
tools.wait_ticks(ticks=20)

print("white arm before/after", wa0 and wa0["v_max"], wa1 and wa1["v_max"])

    handoff("opponent still moving", a=wa0, b=wa1)
rings = P.table_rings(h1)

print("FINAL BOARD", len(bp2), json.dumps(bp2))
print("arms", {a: (round(v['dpos_m'], 5), v['at_reset']) for a, v in P.arms_at_reset().items()})
